Usage

When to use. Citation Previews surface a brief in-line glimpse of referenced source material — including a link and abstract — without interrupting reading flow. They let readers quickly assess the content the model reasoned over without leaving the response.

Do

  • Anchor the card to a citation pill and reveal it on hover / focus.
  • Lead each row with a favicon + source name, then the headline and link.
  • Give the active row a subtle backplate and reveal its “more” action.
  • Cap the card height and let the reference list scroll within it.

Don't

  • Block reading flow — the preview is ephemeral, not a modal.
  • Pack full article bodies in — show headline + link, defer depth to the References panel.
  • Show the row “more” button on every row at rest — reveal it on the active row.
  • Let headlines run past two lines — clamp and truncate the URL.
